name: state_set
description: Write or update a temporary fact that is true now. This complements long-term memory and must not duplicate stable identity or permanent facts. Keep lifecycle explicit: planned is only a plan; in_progress is happening; unknown means not confirmed. Never turn a plan into completed merely because time passed. Use scope=today for today's food, water, sleep, delivery and schedule; use scope=current only for cross-day temporary context and provide a review TTL.

source_ref.description: Message or source reference when available

name: state_get
description: Read active temporary facts before asking a repeated question or assuming an old fact is still current. Treat planned as not done. Empty means unknown, not false.

name: state_drop
description: Remove a temporary fact when it ended, was replaced, or was wrong. A tombstone is retained so retrieved old chat must not resurrect it.

reason.description: ended, cancelled, corrected, or another short reason

name: state_tombstones
description: Check whether an old temporary fact was explicitly ended, expired, or superseded before restoring it from chat retrieval.
